previews.output_timing: 30 fps image repetition; no generated or interpolated motion; at most one output-frame timestamp rounding
previews.crop: Floating-window chrome removed at x=3 y=35
previews.visual_quality_review: Root inspected genuine countdown frames and timestamped video contact sheet; central banner and red ETA are readable.

limitations: One initial position fixture places the local pawn in supported deep water; no repeated repositioning or peers.
Circular AddMovementInput exercises normal CMC acceleration; this is not a hardware-input or balance playthrough.
Default drain is preferred. Any accelerated SwimEnergyPerSecond is recorded and confined to this PIE pawn.
Drowning grace, health, energy, flood clock, collision and damage are never assigned or advanced by the probe.
Native wave crests may briefly lift the swimmer into air. Such breaches are recorded, bounded to 2.5 s, cannot recover reserve, and never receive a new position fixture.
Water death attribution uses the native countdown, deep water at the terminal transition and health/damage timestamp; Status exposes no reflected last-source actor.
No network clients, packages saved, build, editor map switch or broad test suite.
reports.capture_validation: All source captures have supported client dimensions; visual review remains separate

limitations: Sampled genuine engine screenshots do not record every game frame.
CFR output repeats source images at their actual game-time intervals; no interpolation or title cards.
Excluded nonclient captures stay recorded in report metadata. Their genuine time gaps remain as holds of preceding accepted frames; no wrong viewport is resized into output.
PlayerCamera metadata does not establish the screenshot surface; visual review of accepted client captures remains necessary.
The terminal 1 ms and 30 fps duration rounding are presentation padding, not additional observed gameplay.
Telemetry and successful encoding do not establish visual quality; inspect the previews in the gameplay camera.
